title: macrothelypteris sumatrana
intro: Macrothelypteris sumatrana, commonly known as Sumatran maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, contributing to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Macrothelypteris sumatrana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
